notes: Completed the backplate/switch/MetroCluster follow-up work deferred from the previous release. Backplate: separated AFX (a disaggregated compute/storage architecture) out of the dual-controller 11-slot chassis layout that falsely implied traditional numbered PCIe I/O slots -- AFX now renders honestly grouped by port role instead. Widened entry-2U platform detection to cover AFF/ASA A20/A30/A50 and C20/C30/C60 and FAS500 (previously fell to a bare generic layout with no model-aware chassis description). Reconciled the two disconnected switch-firmware-baseline data stores: tools/reference_harvester.py now propagates its live-harvested Cisco/Brocade/Broadcom version numbers from data/imt_interop.json into data/firmware_baselines.json's switches section on every enrichment run, instead of the latter being a second, manually-maintained copy that could silently drift stale. Added licenses, pvrs, and downtimeEvents to the fallback GraphQL query tier (added incrementally with live field-count-limit testing after last release's regression) -- confirmed live with real (empty, i.e. genuinely no PVRs/downtime events for this account) data, no accounts pushed to a worse query tier. Fixed a real bug found by a MetroCluster-focused audit: fleet_signals['metrocluster'] was permanently False due to a queried-field-name mismatch (checked for 'isMetroClusterConfigured', a key that was never set anywhere -- the real field is 'isMetroCluster'), silently suppressing MetroCluster vendor-guideline articles from ever being recommended even for genuine MetroCluster fleets. Added a new mcContext flag (server.py, sourced from the confirmed-real per-system isMetroCluster field) that flags which harvested switches sit on a MetroCluster ISL, and wired it into the Switch Validation tab to surface real MC ISL requirement context (packet loss/jitter/MTU limits) instead of validating MC switches identically to plain cluster-interconnect switches -- confirmed live against 8 real MetroCluster systems in the test account (NVIDIA Cumulus ISL switches correctly flagged). Corrected two stale TR-4517 citations to a version-agnostic NetApp search link, since MetroCluster technical reports get renumbered/superseded across ONTAP releases and this tool cannot verify a specific TR number is still current.
